run_when: After scoring, for companies that passed.

prompt.task: Write the company-level fit message using the template and rules below.
prompt.definition:
Template:
{{company}} {{observation}}.

Most founders at that stage are still {{current_state}} and finding out where cash actually stands three weeks after the month ends.

Puzzle is modern accounting software for founders who'd rather build than bookkeep. It plugs straight into {{detected_fintech_tools}}, categorizes ~95% of transactions automatically, and keeps burn, runway and ARR current every day, so the board deck doesn't wait on a close.

Worth 20 minutes?
watch_out_for: Generated per company, not per person: no first name, no greeting, no sign-off
Never leave a placeholder unfilled; rewrite the sentence instead
End on the question; never include a booking link
{{current_state}} is an assumption: lead with 'fighting QuickBooks' unless research contradicts it
{{detected_fintech_tools}} names only tools actually found; if none, write 'your bank, card and payroll accounts'
Observation ideas: raised recently, just converted to a Delaware C-Corp, is hiring across several roles, launched paid pricing, registered a second entity, is heading into its first full tax year
Current state ideas: fighting QuickBooks, categorizing transactions by hand, paying a bookkeeper $1-2k a month for the basics, rebuilding runway in a spreadsheet, months behind on the books

web_search.why: Writes text from answers already found; no new facts needed.
